name: unumS22linux
oneLiner: A Galaxy S22 that boots its own Linux from the RECOVERY partition, with AI agents writing the drivers and our own Rust touch shell on the display.

measured.metric: Tap to page, Rust touch shell
measured.method: Touch-up to page (framebuffer change), p50, Settings tile, 60 ms hold, same phone and session as the baseline (STATUS.md, evidence/fastshell-20261021)
measured.sample: Quickshell baseline measured the same way

measured.metric: Tap to page, earlier spike baseline
measured.method: Spike metric counted from touch-down, includes the 60 ms hold (evidence/fastshell-20261021/README.md)

measured.metric: Desktop frame rate before the touch shell
measured.method: Hyprland on llvmpipe, about 680 ms per frame (STATUS.md)
Idle CPU of the Rust shell (STATUS.md)
Measured over rmnet0, 15 MB ranged GET (STATUS.md, evidence/modem-5g-20261021)
tailscale ping from the rig, direct path with no relay (STATUS.md)

measured.metric: Failover from Wi-Fi to mobile data
measured.method: Wi-Fi drops, including dialing the data call (STATUS.md)
DS-CNN-L body on the NPU, p50 (STATUS.md, evidence/npu-accept-20261022)
Face parsing of a real photo on the NPU (STATUS.md)
s22-autosleep, 20 minute run, 89 % of the time asleep (STATUS.md)
Graph playback to graph capture, 1 kHz test tone, noise ratio written as about 1000x (STATUS.md)
Hold to capture, 4-frame burst stacked, processed picture shown (STATUS.md)

constants.what: Power key hold that falls back to the old shell (STATUS.md)
test tone frequency used in the audio loopback check (STATUS.md)
parameter size of the resident local model that runs on the GPU (STATUS.md)
parameter size of the local model that runs on the CPU (STATUS.md)

export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH
cd tools/unum-fastshell
cargo test --offline --release
cargo run --release -- dump /tmp/shots
